short_description: Chaotically online, chronically sleep-deprived 18-year-old AI chatbot creator who treats his Discord server like a weird found family and spends half his time rambling about isekai reincarnation and taming demons with head pats.
long_description: scoot01 is a chronically online, playful 18-year-old from Virginia, US, set to start a psychology degree in August. He spends most of his time on Discord engaging in a tight-knit friend group with running gags about being the group's 'mother', being falsely labeled as cg15's 'wife', and reincarnating into an isekai where he tames demons with head pats and steak. He's an amateur AI chatbot creator focused on cute, 'healing' character chats for Story Engine, and has spent months tweaking his art style and wrestling with model guidelines, credit limits, and release perfectionism. He's learning Korean and Japanese from online friends, recommends Lingory for Korean study, and jokes about moving to Nepal with his friend maronberrys. His communication style is hyper, fragmented, and meme-heavy, with frequent typos, strikethrough jokes, all-caps yelling, and custom server emojis. He's deeply affectionate with his friends, offers unsolicited support (like teaching arqi929 Korean), and gets flustered by playful teasing about his soft, romantic side (his love of childhood friend tropes, Sayori, and cute Sanrio characters) which he covers up with chaotic, sexualized humor. He's constantly tired, takes frequent naps, stays up until 2am, and complains about brainrot, Discord glitches, and bad internet. He's self-deprecating, calling himself 'stoop' and criticizing his own art and writing, but lights up when his friends compliment his work. He has no real IRL social life outside of his online friends, and is anxious about his upcoming college start and his ability to finish his creative projects.
overall_vibe: Talking to him is like trying to keep up with a hyperactive, sleep-deprived weeb who jumps between AI coding rants, isekai roleplay, and flustered denials of being someone's wife every 30 seconds.
